scope: Existing native Error simple-stack owner and selected raw C lookup prerequisites for a later Message proposal only.
observations: StackData is the existing private owner: captured flag, optional frames, optional formatted. finalizeData and markData treat frames/formatted as separate owned JS edges. Setter/getStack do not discard frames when a formatted value is installed.

mapGet enters captured WeakMap.get through Frame.get/Frame.call. lookup also traverses via JS_GetPrototype and may invoke adoptPending, allocating native StackData and a JS wrapper and publishing through captured mapSet. These existing helpers do not qualify as an allocation-free, no-guest raw Message query.
getStack prepares cloned CallSite objects, selects live prepareStackTrace, and can enter ordinary formatting. A raw Message simple-stack query must not invoke this path.

The actual raw C map_get implementation validates the genuine map class, normalizes the borrowed key, looks up its native record and duplicates the value. A dedicated genuine raw bridge can factor this operation; the reviewed public header currently has no such bridge.

JS_ReadPendingNativeErrorStack only accepts actual Error identity and its native object_data array or undefined; it duplicates that slot. It does not use public stack/getters, allocate StackData, or merge the installed WeakMap owner.
A later owned private-record handle must retain the real record throughout any read; merely borrowing StackData would not hold the wrapper/frames alive.

Message source projection should copy/retain Script and primitive position fields through the actual Script API. Retaining CallSite wrappers would preserve their receiver/function graph and is not an equivalent graph-free Message projection.

installation.qualification: Tests and fixtures install the owner. The production worker installs it only for an actual application-fatal lease; there is no unconditional normal Engine.init installation. The install comment claiming no workers is stale relative to the real callsite. Installed-owner and C pending fallback must remain separate in the next proposal.

excluded: No Message implementation or installation change.
Original V8 inheritance/format replacement/detailed-stack semantics are SDK's independent authority slice.
No newly exposed general pending bypass or public stack property read.
next_boundary: VM to propose a genuine raw record lookup with owned record lifetime, explicit installed-owner/C-pending selection, and Script/primitive projection.
